# Revcord sqlite3 prebuild (ARMv7)

Bundled `node_sqlite3.node` from [Revcord v1.2](https://github.com/mayudev/revcord/releases/tag/v1.2):

- Package: sqlite3 **5.1.6**
- Target: `napi-v6-linux-glibc-arm` (ELF32 ARM hard-float)
- Source URL: https://github.com/mayudev/revcord/releases/download/v1.2/node_sqlite3.node

Used by the RM2 jonobones installer when the tablet has no `wget`/`curl`.
Upstream license: see the Revcord project (MIT). This binary is redistributed for offline install convenience.
